mcai_companion.tutorial.body.0: Select an Agent from the left. Each finished Agent will own a distinct body, memory, model profile, and skin.
mcai_companion.tutorial.body.1: Choose a unique 3–16 character name, accent, 0.0–1.0 model temperature, and optional local skin.
mcai_companion.tutorial.body.2: Enter the provider URL, API key, model name, and optional system preferences. Save runs a live capability check.
mcai_companion.tutorial.body.3: Send the first ordinary message after verification. In single-player, speak naturally; no @ mention is required.
mcai_companion.screen.skin.title: Agent Skin
mcai_companion.skin.drop_instruction: Drag one skin PNG onto this window
mcai_companion.skin.requirements: Modern 64×64 PNG, alpha channel, at most 1 MiB. Remote URLs are never downloaded. On a dedicated server the file must also be available to the server owner.
